name: ESP32-S3 SuperMini
description: Thumb-sized ESP32-S3 board (S3FH4R2: 4 MB flash, 2 MB PSRAM) with USB-C and an RGB LED for about $5; dual-core S3 power in the SuperMini form factor.
notes: The 35 GPIOs counted by espboards.dev include pads on the underside; the two side headers alone carry fewer. Several different 'S3 SuperMini' layouts exist: check the pinout of your exact listing.
Embedded 2 MB quad PSRAM is disabled by default: enable 'QSPI PSRAM' in the Arduino tools menu or in ESPHome.
No UART bridge: enable 'USB CDC On Boot' for Serial output over the native USB port.
The red LED and the RGB LED share GPIO48. Some units ship with the ceramic antenna mounted wrongly (weak Wi-Fi); a ~31 mm wire antenna fixes it.
No official vendor page; data from espboards.dev.
